entries.symptom: The selected-snapshot recovery estimate did not explain roughly 1.9 TB of occupied filesystem space.
entries.cause: Selected logical checkpoint bytes, total Hugging Face logical bytes, Docker image/build-cache attribution, and filesystem used bytes are different quantities.
entries.resolution: Added model-cache-inventory/v1 with filesystem capacity/used/available, repository/snapshot logical bytes, incomplete bytes, Docker unique bytes, references, containers, and timestamp caveats.

entries.symptom: A fixed recipe GPU identity was not portable to the current host mapping.
entries.cause: Docker GPU constraints and CUDA visibility needed the discovered campaign device rather than a copied host identity.
entries.resolution: Added an explicit guarded --gpu-device recipe-load override that pins Docker and CUDA visibility together.

entries.symptom: The pinned video decoder recovered only four of 112 frames from each Creative Commons WebM and warned about 108 broken frames.
entries.cause: The original WebM encodings were poorly supported by the pinned OpenCV/vLLM decode path.
entries.resolution: Retained the licensed originals and generated deterministic pinned MP4 derivatives with provenance and SHA-256 hashes; the corpus now uses the derivatives.

entries.symptom: HTTP failures hid the bounded upstream response body needed to diagnose exact context overflow.
entries.cause: The preflight error path retained only the HTTP status exception.
entries.resolution: Captured and bounded the HTTPError response body and added regression coverage.

entries.symptom: A correct suggestion to stream TTS was marked as a timeout-triage failure.
entries.cause: The deterministic latency-fix allowlist recognized parallelization but omitted streaming.
entries.resolution: Added the semantically valid streaming marker and a regression test; the unchanged NVFP4 model then passed the repeated quality suite.

entries.symptom: vLLM reported no E=256,N=512 FP8 MoE config for the RTX PRO 6000 and warned that performance might be sub-optimal.
entries.cause: The pinned nightly contains no matching hardware-specific fused-MoE JSON.
entries.resolution: Started the exact pinned benchmark_moe.py tuner and required a default-versus-tuned end-to-end A/B before recommendation.

entries.symptom: The first tuner launch failed when Ray parsed the Docker-visible GPU UUID as an integer.
entries.cause: The official worker assumes ray.get_gpu_ids()[0] is numeric.
entries.resolution: Kept Docker constrained to the exact UUID while exposing physical CUDA device 1 numerically inside the isolated tuner.

entries.symptom: The initial estimate treated 1,920 candidates as the complete run.
entries.cause: The official tuner evaluates 1,920 configurations independently for every requested batch size.
entries.resolution: Report completed batches against all 18 planned batches and extrapolate a duration range from completed batch timings.

entries.symptom: The first full pytest invocation ended with a Windows invalid-output-pipe traceback.
entries.cause: An accidental 10-second shell deadline terminated pytest while it was writing progress.
entries.resolution: Classified it as a harness timeout and restarted exactly one hidden captured pytest process.

entries.symptom: The completed temporary tuner container was unavailable for a final exit-state inspection.
entries.cause: The authorized tuner launch used automatic container removal.
entries.resolution: Validated the durable artifact against all 18 planned batch-size keys, retained its write timestamp and hash, and recorded the missing final exit record as an evidence limit.

entries.symptom: The first derived image copied more repository configuration than the exact tune.
entries.cause: Docker resolved a broad configs source path against the repository build context.
entries.resolution: Narrowed the image layer to the exact nested tune path, rebuilt, and verified the in-image SHA-256 against the manifest.

entries.symptom: The product logs command could not find a recipe-loaded candidate container.
entries.cause: Log discovery was limited to serves present in the operator manifest.
entries.resolution: Used a narrow read-only Docker log capture for this campaign and retained recipe-loaded container log discovery as a product gap.

entries.symptom: The capacity artifact did not retain enough per-request timing decomposition for publication.
entries.cause: The prior schema emphasized TTFT, E2E, and aggregate throughput.
entries.resolution: Added capacity-v3 with per-request TTFT, effective prefill, generation duration, decode rate, mean inter-token latency, exact token counts, wall time, and explicit client-observed methodology.

entries.symptom: The first routed smoke returned no visible answer after 1,024 completion tokens.
entries.cause: The isolated router did not hard-set the campaign's thinking-disabled production contract.
entries.resolution: Pinned chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=false in the qualification tier and reran the routed preflight successfully.

entries.symptom: Malformed upstream video and unsupported cross-dialect video surfaced as generic HTTP 500 responses.
entries.cause: The front door treated every relay exception as an internal fault and streaming relay setup deferred request rejection until after response setup.
entries.resolution: Added typed sanitized backend client errors, eager request validation and stream opening, safe 400/413/415/422 propagation, and retained upstream 5xx as internal errors.

entries.symptom: Four start captures used a .json extension but contained a container ID line followed by a JSON command envelope.
entries.cause: The lifecycle command emitted both the raw container ID and structured output to the same capture.
entries.resolution: Renamed the captures to .log so every retained .json artifact is parseable as one JSON document.

entries.symptom: The recipe loader had no symmetric unload command for campaign teardown.
entries.cause: models recipes currently exposes load but not stop/remove lifecycle.
entries.resolution: Verified the exact container ID, stopped and removed only that campaign container, and captured the restored serve/router state. A durable symmetric unload verb remains a product gap.
